effectiveCorrectiveRule.preflight: Keep original operator/owner/customer validity checks and their existing timing.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.order: Open the business entity transaction, then call the existing numbering next entry through another checked-out connection; after the number succeeds, perform the original entity/session flush and commit.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.independentConnectionMeaning: The number operation must not borrow the already-open business transaction. It may use another connection from the existing shared pool; a second pool is not required by this decision.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.customerBusinessTransaction: customer + primary alias + pending managed session retain their original atomic business boundary.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.projectBusinessTransaction: project + pending managed session retain their original atomic business boundary.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.failure: Entity failure rolls back business rows/session changes in that business transaction but does not compensate or rewind a counter already independently committed.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.numberFailure: Stop before entity writes and preserve the original error behavior; do not add retry, refill, compensation, stronger locks or isolation.
effectiveCorrectiveRule.preserveDateAndFormatting: Keep original scope, UTC period, per-caller time capture and formatting; this corrective does not change IDs, payloads or numbering syntax.
